component.name: Caelum
component.summary: Live sky overlay for your desktop

description.p: Caelum turns your desktop background into a live sky: the real position of the sun, moon, planets and stars for your location, with clouds, rain and snow from live weather data.

ul.li: 240° panorama centred on your screen's real-world facing direction
Moon phase with correct crescent orientation for your latitude
Weekly and hourly forecast from Open-Meteo and MET Norway (no API key)
Constellation lines, Milky Way, planets and meteors on clear nights
Optional live compass from your phone over the network
Can export the sky as your wallpaper and lock screen

screenshot.caption: Sunset over a tree-lined plain with sunlit clouds, the moon and planets, and the weekly forecast
A clear night with constellations, planets and the Milky Way
Rain over the mountains: the distance fades into the downpour
A partly cloudy morning sky over the desktop
Settings: the Sky tab, with the opaque sky and the choice of landscape

description.p: The weather now, as measured where you are.

ul.li: Rain, clouds, temperature, humidity and wind come from the most accurate free observation covering your location: weather radar, then the nearest airport's reports, with the forecast as the fallback
Settings → Location shows where each one comes from
When the snap is updated while Caelum runs, Caelum tells you to restart it to use the new version

description.p: Realistic rain and snow, and safer network use.

ul.li: Rain falls continuously, behind and in front of the landscape, slanting with the real wind
Rain and snow hide the distance in a haze, darken the clouds and wet the ground
Grey rain shafts hang under passing showers
Lightning only during thunderstorms: the sky flashes while the landscape stays a silhouette
Bigger snowflakes that drift and sway
Location detection now uses an encrypted connection
Your coordinates are sent to the weather services rounded to about 1 km
The dark band at the bottom is replaced by a photographed landscape: a green plain with trees, mountains or the sea
It turns with the direction you face and is relit by the sun and moon, from full daylight to golden hour, twilight and moonlit night
The sun, moon and clouds set behind the trees and mountains
Choose it in Settings, Sky tab: the photos, the old drawn hills, or nothing
The photos are CC0 panoramas from Poly Haven

description.p: Easier to find your way around the settings.

ul.li: Settings are organised in four tabs: Sky, Display, Location and System
Options are grouped under headings, and the less obvious ones have a short explanation
The settings window reopens on the tab you used last
Italian translations for the features added in 1.3.0
New settings screenshot

description.p: A sky that no longer depends on your wallpaper, and a desktop you can use while it runs.

ul.li: Opaque sky, on by default: Caelum paints the whole sky itself, bright blue by day and black at night, whatever your wallpaper
The exported desktop background and lock screen now show a real daytime sky
Click-through: clicks on the sky reach your desktop icons and windows; only the gear, compass and forecast cards respond
Explore mode: click the compass or a forecast card to see constellation names on hover
Fresh weather right after waking from suspend or hibernation
The version is shown in Settings, and caelum --version prints it
New screenshots

description.p: More realistic clouds and a lighter load on the computer.

ul.li: The sun and moon are hidden only while a cloud is actually in front of them, instead of being dimmed by the cloud-cover percentage
Thin high cirrus no longer hides the sun or greys the sky
Low clouds fill the whole sky in perspective: big grey-bottomed clouds overhead, small cumulus toward the horizon
Clouds drift with the real wind direction and speed
Overcast skies show a grey cloud ceiling; a high, thin layer shows the sun as a dim disc
Planets appear with twilight instead of in daylight
Much lower CPU use: the cloud layer is cached and redrawn only when it changes
New screenshots
Cloud-cover badge: the low-cloud value is no longer hidden and the text stays inside the card
New screenshots

description.p: Available on Flathub, the Snap Store and a Launchpad PPA.

ul.li: Wallpaper export and autostart work inside Flatpak and Snap
Objects outside the 240° view are hidden instead of piling up at the screen edges
Moon phase name now matches the nearest phase (e.g. Waxing Gibbous at 10 days)

description.p: App icon now shown on Caelum windows (dock, Alt+Tab), also when run from source.
